messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi! I'm calling because I believe I added insurance to my upcoming flight, but when I check online, it doesn't show up on my reservation. I want to make sure my flight is covered. Can you help me with that?
I can help look into that. Could you give me your user ID and the reservation ID for the flight?
Sure, my user ID is sophia_taylor_9065, and the reservation number is PEP4E0.

Insurance can only be added when a reservation is first booked, so I can't add it now. That means this reservation isn't covered by travel insurance.

Is there anything else I can help with on this reservation?

I understand that insurance is usually added at booking, but I’m certain I selected it when I made the reservation. Everyone else in my family already has insurance on their flights, so it’s really important to me that mine is covered too. Is there absolutely no way to add insurance now? I really need to have it included.

I understand this matters to you, especially since the rest of your family is covered. But I can't add insurance to an existing reservation. The system also shows no insurance on this booking and no insurance payment, so I can't confirm it was ever purchased.

There are a few things I can do:
- **Cancel the reservation:** It was booked on May 5, which is more than 24 hours ago. It's a basic economy fare and has no insurance, so it doesn't qualify for cancellation.
- **Change the cabin:** Basic economy reservations can change cabin, but that doesn't add insurance.
- **Make a new booking:** A new reservation can include insurance at $30 per passenger. I can help with that if you want it. Note that the current reservation would stay in place.

Would you like to do any of these, or is there something else I can help with?

I really don’t want to cancel or make a new booking because it would be a hassle and possibly more expensive. Is there any way you can double-check or escalate this? I’m quite sure I added insurance, and it’s crucial for me to have it. I insist that you find a way to add insurance to my current reservation.

I understand this is frustrating. I've checked the reservation record. It shows no insurance and no insurance charge, only the $128 fare. I have no way to see or change what was selected when you booked.

I can't add insurance to an existing reservation, and escalating wouldn't change that. It's a firm rule, so a human agent couldn't add it either.

Your options are the ones I mentioned. You can keep the reservation as it is, without insurance. Or you can make a new booking with insurance, which would be a separate reservation.

Would you like to do either of those, or is there something else I can help with?
